column7: FIX-3088 follow-up: an audit event emitted through core with no EventTime was stored and hashed as 0001-01-01, whose seconds-resolution local-mean-time offset on a non-UTC host broke audit row 1 across a Postgres backup/restore. prepareAuditEventForEmit (the core choke point for emitAudit, emitAuditOn, emitAuditWithAccessLog, owed and secret-mutation audits) now sets a zero EventTime to now, UTC, microseconds, before the store hashes the row; an explicit time is kept and VerifyAuditChain stays valid. Red on main. The storage audit write path is unchanged; direct storage.LogAuditEvent writers are not covered (INV-CORE-audit-event-time-never-zero).
